text:
Based on my experience, I cannot recommend this pet hotel. Please be cautious—to my point of view, they seem more focused on money than on genuine care for pets or customers!

I recently left my dog at this pet hotel for the first time, as it’s close to my home and initially seemed professional and trustworthy. Sadly, my experience proved otherwise.

The first issue was that staff fed my dog the portion of food and wrong timing even I give clear instruction!... More seriously, on the fourth day, my dog developed a severe allergic reaction. The hospital could not provide a clear explanation. When I questions them about the cleanliness, they just simply explain that they collected the skin sample and do the microscopic examination, found large amount of inflammatory cells with bacteria and the dog that has underlying skin condition might develop the skin infection when the air humidity is high...

I had to urgently move him back to the hotel he normally stays at. He had never experienced this before, but this time his skin became infected and the condition spread rapidly.

When I raised the matter with the hospital, they dismissed it by saying my dog simply had allergies and refused to take any responsibility. Even when I spoke with the manager, they insisted the treatment provided was sufficient and failed to acknowledge that this situation should never have occurred in the first place—especially if proper cleanliness and care had been maintained.

Unfortunately, with my experience this place has shown no accountability toward this situation. Based on my experience, I cannot recommend this pet hotel. Please be cautious—to my point of view, they seem more focused on money than on genuine care for pets or customers.

text: Hi, my cat has been getting baths and veterinary care at this hospital for a year, but this time the service was terrible. 1: My cat went for a bath today. Before the bath, the vet would come to check on the cat, but this service was cancelled today without prior notice. I felt disrespected because as a customer, I have the right to know. I like this hospital because of its unique feature: a pre-bath check-up for cats. 2: I demanded an apology from the staff. Our home is quite far from the hospital, and it takes a long time and is expensive to get a taxi. However, the service and the vet's pre-bath check-up are more important to me. Although the staff apologized, she pressed her hands on the table, which felt very impolite and insincere. 3: Previously, cat baths took about an hour and a half, but today it was only 40 minutes. I asked the staff why it was only 40 minutes. They replied that it was because my cat's fur is very short. I asked, "Has my cat ever grown fur?" When I left, the staff didn't help me get my cat to my car, and they were chatting. In conclusion: 1. The customer has the right to know. If your hospital has made any changes, you should inform the customer beforehand, instead of waiting until the customer arrives at the hospital. This is disrespectful and impolite because the customer has the right to choose. 2. You have fewer doctors, which means my cat couldn't have a check-up or bath beforehand. This is a change in your hospital and has nothing to do with the customer. You can't make the customer bear your losses and shift the responsibility to them. 3. In my mind, you are a five-star hospital, not a three-star or one-star hospital. Now you are doing a very poor job, so I am very disappointed and saddened. A hospital is a sacred place for me, and I respect you. You have lost your advantages. Therefore, unless there are special circumstances, my cat will never go to your hospital again. I don't like paying money to suffer!

text:
I was actually hesitant to bring my cat to a proper pet hospital because in my previous country, a vet hospital nearly cost us 2000 euro just for a misdiagnosis.

My thoughts changed when I brought my cat Tifa to Arak Animal Hospital. First of all, they have different entry for cat and dog patients (so cute!). After that, they have a cute waiting area for humans with a separate play area for cats.

Tifa was handled by Dr. Boat. He diagnosed Tifa with FIP and he had to undergo nearly 3-month medication. The attention that was given by the doctor and the staff of Arak was very touching. They were so calm when handling Tifa, sometimes one of the staff came to play with Tifa for a little bit. It was very clear that they work there not only because it's their job but also because they love animals. They texted me through LINE to ask about Tifa's well-being, and also responded when I send them updates about my cat. Tifa is now FIP-free and a very happy cat.

Unfortunately I stop going to this hospital because we have moved quite far away, but Arak Animal Hospital will hold a special place in my (and Tifa's) heart.
